toys.name: Toys
toys.description: Level up the fun with our collection of 3D-printed toys, games, and storage essentials! From sleek card deck holders and board game organisers to interactive fidgets, display pieces, and playful gadgets, we bring your favourite pastimes to life. Whether you're looking for clever gaming accessories to keep game night organised or unique, durable toys to spark imagination, our creations are built for play, made to last, and designed to bring extra joy to kids and adults alike.

items.name: UNO Playing card box
items.details:
Keep your UNO cards protected and always ready for the next game.

This 3D printed card box is designed to fit a standard UNO deck. The secure clips hold the lid firmly closed, so your cards stay safe whether you're at home, travelling or storing them on a shelf.

Built to last. Easy to open. Compact enough to take anywhere.

gwm.name: GWM
gwm.description: Custom and replacement 3D printed parts/accessories for GWM vehicles.

items.name: GWM Rear Floor Clip-on Cup Holder
items.details: This cup holder clips seamlessly onto the factory centre console on the floor, utilising the existing trim lines for a secure, wiggle-free fit. It features built-in drink storage alongside a dedicated slot to keep a cellphone safe and accessible. No drilling, no permanent modifications, and no flimsy plastic inserts required. Whether you’re tackling rough 4x4 trails or navigating daily school runs, this upgrade ensures your passengers' drinks and phone stay firmly in place.

items.name: GWM P300 Rear Armrest Slide-in Cup Holder
items.details:
This custom-engineered, 3D-printed cup holder drops right into place in seconds. Designed to slide smoothly and snugly into the back-seat centre armrest, giving your passengers a stable, secure place for their favourite drinks. No clips, no screws, and no permanent vehicle modifications required.

With a built-in storage slot it’s perfect for the rear-seat essentials that always seem to get lost in the footwell, whether that's a cell phone, a charging cable, a pen, or a pack of mints.

items.name: GWM P300 - Front centre console Cup Holder
items.details:
This 3D printed raised insert drops straight into your existing cup holder and lifts both cups to a comfortable, reachable height. No modifications. No tools. No drilling.

Clean matte black finish that matches your interior.
Easy to remove and clean.

items.name: GWM P300 Fuel Cap Holder - PETROL
items.details:
Designed specifically for the GWM P300, this practical accessory keeps your fuel cap clean, protected, and off your vehicle's paintwork during refueling. It also makes life easier for fuel attendants by providing a convenient spot to safely place the cap instead of letting it dangle or searching for somewhere to put it.

The clearly printed PETROL or DIESEL label, provides an instant visual reminder of the correct fuel type. This helps reduce the risk of costly fuel mix-ups and gives both drivers and attendants extra peace of mind at the pump.
